jobs.title: Senior Manager, Strategic Growth Acceleration
jobs.description: About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Overview: This role is focused on revenue realisation for Visa Commercial Solutions Europe’s New Verticals team. The core objective is simple: help signed vertical deals turn into launched programs, active payment flows and net revenue. The New Verticals team is one of the most exciting growth areas within VCS. We are building Visa’s presence in spaces where the B2B payments opportunity is still being shaped, tested and scaled. In many ways, the team operates like a start-up inside a large global company: working in new areas, developing propositions as we go, and turning early success into repeatable growth. This is an important moment for the team. Over the last two years, New Verticals has moved from early exploration to real commercial traction, including developing new propositions and signing its first major deals. The next stage is about scaling that success, and this role will help us do that by supporting clients to activate what we have sold, accelerate revenue and build the next wave of growth across freight, insurance and digital commerce. The role will suit someone who wants to help build something new inside a large global company. It offers the variety of an early stage growth environment, with the reach, client access and resources of Visa behind it. The role will be split across two connected areas: Revenue realisation: helping clients successfully deploy, launch and grow the solutions Visa has sold. Vertical growth acceleration: supporting strategy, GTM, business development, client engagement and sales enablement across the portfolio. This is a broad, hands-on role for someone who enjoys ambiguity, variety and commercial problem-solving. The right person will be comfortable moving between client conversations, GTM planning, program coordination, market analysis and internal stakeholder management. What we expect of you, day to day. Drive revenue realisation: Help signed vertical deals convert into live programs, active usage and net revenue. Support clients through deployment, launch planning and early program growth. Advise clients on GTM strategy, customer targeting, sales enablement and activation. Identify where Visa marketing, advisory or funding support can help accelerate take up. Track deal progress from signature to launch, ramp-up and revenue contribution. Spot blockers early and coordinate the right internal teams to solve them. Accelerate vertical growth: Support the development of growth strategies across the New Verticals portfolio. Translate market insight and client feedback into clear propositions and use cases. Help define Visa’s value proposition, messaging and route to market. Build target account thinking and support opportunity prioritisation. Support client pitches, workshops and solution-design conversations. Help clusters and account teams pursue local opportunities with the right narrative and materials. Build scalable GTM foundations: Develop simple, practical playbooks that help teams repeat what works. Capture learnings from live deals and turn them into guidance for future opportunities. Create client facing and internal materials that make the proposition easy to understand. Work with product, legal, compliance, marketing, finance and commercial teams to move priority opportunities forward. Help communicate progress, impact and priorities to senior stakeholders. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Experience: Experience in business development, strategy, consulting, growth, partnerships, client success or another commercial role. Experience working with B2B clients, platforms, fintechs, technology businesses or complex partnership models. Proven ability to move from strategy to execution. Track record of managing cross-functional work involving multiple internal and external stakeholders. Experience creating client materials, commercial narratives, GTM plans or activation plans. Beneficial, but not required: experience launching or scaling client programmes that drive adoption, usage and revenue. Payments or financial services experience would be helpful, but is not essential. Skills and competencies: Structured thinker and problem solver, comfortable working through ambiguous or unfamiliar topics. Commercially minded, with good judgement on where to focus and how to turn opportunities into growth. Strong with clients and stakeholders, able to build rapport, present clearly and manage senior relationships. Clear communicator, able to turn complex ideas into simple narratives, practical recommendations and strong materials. Organised and collaborative operator, able to coordinate across functions, markets and client teams to keep complex work moving. Practical GTM skillset, including proposition development, sales enablement and activation planning. Adaptable and proactive, with the energy to help build a new growth area inside VCS. About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description What is it all about? Visa is looking for a commercially minded and relationship-driven Senior Manager, Acceptance Development to help accelerate acceptance growth across Romania, Croatia, Slovenia, and Bulgaria (RCSB). In this role, you will work at the intersection of payments, partnerships, and business development, helping merchants and acquirers unlock new opportunities to grow electronic payments adoption. You will collaborate with leading acquirers, payment service providers (PSPs), merchants, fintechs, and internal Visa stakeholders to identify opportunities, drive strategic acceptance initiatives, and strengthen Visa's position as the preferred payments partner in the region. From developing business cases and scaling innovative acceptance solutions to supporting market-wide growth initiatives, you will play a key role in expanding the reach and impact of digital payments across the cluster. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building partnerships, influencing stakeholders, identifying new growth opportunities, and delivering measurable business results in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. What we expect of you, day by day: Partner with internal Visa teams to identify, develop, and execute opportunities that drive acceptance growth across the RCSB cluster. Build and maintain strong relationships with acquirers, payment service providers, merchants, and other ecosystem partners to support sustainable market expansion. Serve as the primary point of contact for key acquiring partners, helping strengthen engagement and grow Visa's acceptance footprint. Take ownership of strategic acceptance development initiatives across Romania, Croatia, Slovenia, and Bulgaria, ensuring successful execution and delivery against business objectives. Identify, assess, and prioritize new business opportunities, including cross-selling and upselling Visa products and Value-Added Services (VAS). Analyze market opportunities and segment clients, industries, and merchant categories to focus efforts on the highest-growth potential areas. Support the implementation and management of commercial agreements with acquirers and other market participants involved in acceptance initiatives. Act as a subject matter expert on acquiring and acceptance solutions, providing guidance and insights to clients and partners. Partner closely with Account Managers and other cross-functional teams to drive business development and deepen client engagement through Visa's acceptance and acquiring capabilities. Support Visa preference initiatives and marketing activities, ensuring effective execution of key client programs and acceptance campaigns. Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and emerging payment technologies to identify new opportunities for growth. Drive multiple projects simultaneously, delivering high-quality outcomes on time and in line with stakeholder expectations. Build strong internal and external relationships that contribute to Visa's broader growth strategy and market leadership ambitions. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. 
Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications What we're after... Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Business, Technology, or a related field. An advanced degree (Master's or MBA) is an advantage. Strong experience in merchant acceptance, acquiring, merchant services, payments, financial services, consulting, or business development, ideally in a client-facing commercial environment. Deep understanding of the payments ecosystem, including acquirers, payment service providers, merchants, payment facilitators, acceptance technologies, transaction flows, and third-party partners. Demonstrated success developing and executing acceptance growth strategies that increase electronic payment adoption, merchant sales volume, market share, and Visa preference. Proven ability to build and manage strategic relationships with acquirers, PSPs, merchants, and partners, acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders. Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to identify, quantify, and prioritize business opportunities across merchant segments, acceptance solutions, cross-sell and upsell initiatives, and Value-Added Services. Good understanding of merchant needs across physical, digital, and omnichannel commerce, including eCommerce, contactless payments, mobile acceptance, Tap to Phone, Pay by Link, and emerging acceptance solutions. Ability to translate business strategies into clear priorities, action plans, and measurable outcomes while collaborating effectively across markets and functions. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and storytelling skills, with the ability to leverage data, market insights, and client information to develop compelling business recommendations. Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with confidence engaging senior stakeholders, including executive and C-level audiences. Collaborative and relationship-oriented approach, with the ability to build strong partnerships across Sales, Product, Client Services, Digital, Risk, Legal, Marketing, VCA, and Acceptance teams. Self-motivated and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership, attention to detail, and commitment to delivering high-quality results. Strong presentation and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear and compelling narratives. Experience working with data and Excel is an advantage. Knowledge of Visa products, acceptance solutions, transaction processing, merchant analytics, risk, compliance, and interchange management is a plus. Ability and willingness to travel across the cluster and wider European region as business needs require. Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal. Additional local language skills are considered an advantage. Visa is an EEO Employer Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Risk & FX
jobs.description:
About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Currencycloud was acquired by Visa in December 2021. Our Senior Software Engineers are responsible for implementing an industry-leading API that has already processed over 50 billion USD of cross-border transactions for over 5 million end users, and is available to our clients 24x7. But we're not stopping there, and our engineers are at the forefront of taking us forward to meet the demands of even greater scale. You'll be joining the FX Routing and Aggregation (FXRA) team, responsible for the core FX trading platform that powers Currency Cloud's foreign exchange capabilities. Our team owns multiple microservices spanning FX pricing, risk management, trade routing, market data integration, and treasury operations. Our stack runs on AWS as a set of distributed applications using Kubernetes and a microservice-led architecture. We are also utilizing Kafka for our streaming and PACT for Contract testing. What you'll get to do Build and maintain mission-critical FX trading services including pricing engines, risk management systems, and market data providers Work with real-time FX market data from providers like Barclays and JP Morgan using FIX protocol Design and implement high-throughput, low-latency services handling billions in FX transactions Lead technical discussions around hexagonal architecture, event-driven patterns, and distributed systems design Mentor junior engineers and establish best practices for the team Own your domain end-to-end with clear service boundaries and independent deployment paths Collaborate with Treasury, Trading, and Platform teams across the organization You'll get Clear ownership of your domain A clean modern codebase An independent path to production Strong platform and product support The ability to make real changes with real business value. Our Tech Stack includes Object-oriented programming forms the bulk of our codebase, currently in Java, versions 11+, and ideally Spring boot framework Highly-scalable, highly-available, cloud-native applications on AWS are key to our next phase of growth, are written to 12-factor principles and fit into our microservices architecture Cloud-related tools, services, and distributed system observability to support these applications, such as Docker, Kubernetes, ElasticSearch, log management systems, and Datadog APM, to name but a few API specifications, conforming to the OpenAPI (Swagger) standard, provide a clean boundary both externally between our customers and our product, and internally between our microservices SQL, and large SQL databases, provide the persistence layer for our applications. You’ll be working with (and know the limitations of using) such large datastores Infrastructure automation is primarily owned by the infrastructure team, but you will be a consumer of their work, familiarity with AWS, Terraform and Docker is beneficial Testing approaches, including TDD, BDD and Contract Testing, all form an important part of our approach to quality assurance, ensuring that the code that we write forms products that are fit for use. We currently use a variety of frameworks including JUnit, RSpec and Cucumber Agile development, with teams broadly aligned with the Spotify - Squads and Tribes - model, helps us deliver incremental improvements to our products in an iterative manner. Advocating this model, and joining us on a journey of continuous improvement, is a key attribute of members of our teams Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery pipelines allow us to automate-all-the-things, providing repeatable builds and consistent deployments GitHub, and the GitHub PR review process, forms a core part of our developer workflow, and peer reviews help share knowledge and improve quality Teamwork, and cross-team collaboration, is fundamental to the delivery of our applications. Whilst each application has an independent path to production, there will always be some activities and initiatives that span multiple teams and require cross-team collaboration. Within your team you’ll need to collaborate with a number of stakeholders, including Product Owners and QA, as part of your product development This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. 
Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Qualifications: 5 + years of experience in software development. 2+ years of experience building microservices with Java. Proficient in other programming languages, ideally being comfortable reading Ruby or Scala. Working knowledge of relational databases such as MySQL. Experience designing event based and streaming solutions using Kafka will be valued. Experience building applications that run in Kubernetes would be handy. Hands-on experience delivering high-quality production code with Claude Code. Experience managing working with contractors and outsource teams is important. Experience building in software for financial domain, especially in risk is beneficial. Experience working with agile process and principles. Experience in multiple programming languages, these teams primarily use Java, so experience with microservices in Java is important. Proficient in different programming languages, ideally being comfortable reading Ruby or Scala. Experience designing event based and streaming solutions using Kafka will be valued. Strong SQL knowledge, ability to understand and write complex queries. Working knowledge of relational databases such as MySQL. Experience building applications that run in Kubernetes would be handy. Working in a DevOps environment, or passion and willingness to work in this way. Proven delivery of well-tested, scalable, fault- tolerant and performant solutions. A pragmatic approach to solutions and delivery of technical projects. Have been a driving force not only behind change in your previous roles but also in working in a distributed environment. Having worked in a collaborative environment where you are comfortable reviewing code of your peers. Exceptional structure and attention to detail. Comfortable challenging the status quo and always curious about the way things work. Great written and verbal communication skills. Comfortable working in a scale-up or growth environment and as part of a wider team Visa is an EEO Employer Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Job Description Role Overview The Network Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, and operational support of enterprise WAN, LAN, wireless, and secure connectivity solutions within a corporate network environment. This role has the responsibility for the technical delivery of complex network initiatives, provides advanced troubleshooting expertise, and ensures solutions are implemented reliably, securely, and in alignment with established enterprise architecture standards. The Senior Network Engineer operates with minimal supervision, collaborates closely with Security, Project, and Operations teams, and plays a key role in improving network stability, performance, and operational efficiency. Key Responsibilities Network Design & Implementation Design, plan, and implement enterprise WAN, LAN, wireless, and remote access network solutions in accordance with approved architecture standards. Lead the technical delivery of assigned network projects from detailed design through implementation and operational handoff . Create and maintain low‑level network design documentation , including detailed Visio diagrams, implementation plans, and support handover materials. Assess network performance and capacity to ensure solutions meet current and near‑term business requirements . Operations & Advanced Support Provide third‑level technical support for complex network incidents, including root cause analysis and permanent corrective actions. Analyze network activity and incident trends to identify, remediate, and prevent systemic issues . Support major incidents by providing deep technical expertise and coordination with internal teams and vendors. Security & Compliance Collaborate with Information Security to ensure security and compliance requirements are incorporated into all network designs. Provide technical assistance for the investigation, analysis, and mitigation of network vulnerability alerts. Implement secure networking principles, including segmentation, secure remote access, and policy enforcement. Vendor & Stakeholder Collaboration Work directly with network vendors and service providers to validate designs, troubleshoot complex issues, and support escalations . Collaborate with Project Managers, Account Managers, Security, and Network Operations teams to ensure successful end‑to‑end delivery. Provide clear technical communication to stakeholders across engineering and support organizations. Continuous Improvement & Automation Research, evaluate, and recommend software and hardware enhancements to improve network reliability, scalability, and performance. Use Python and network automation tools to streamline configuration, validation, and troubleshooting tasks. Contribute to service improvement plans that enhance operational efficiency and reduce risk. Knowledge Sharing & Mentorship Provide training, guidance, and technical mentorship to network support engineers. Contribute to internal knowledge bases, standards, and operational documentation. Qualifications Required Bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent professional experience. Minimum of 5 years of experience in enterprise network engineering. Expert‑level knowledge of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF). Advanced understanding of Cisco routing and switching in large enterprise environments. Advanced knowledge of Arista switching . Advanced knowledge of enterprise WAN, LAN, wireless, MPLS, and TCP/IP networking . Advanced experience with Cisco VPN networking . Strong troubleshooting, planning, and problem‑solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Preferred Experience with SD‑WAN technologies , ideally Silver Peak. Working knowledge of SASE solutions . Working knowledge of cloud networking concepts , including hybrid connectivity. Working knowledge of Python and network automation tools. Experience with Citrix NetScaler Access Gateways . Knowledge of Unified Communications and MS Teams solutions. Cisco certification (e.g., CCNA, CCNP or equivalent experience). jobs.title: Sales Enablement Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Why Join Us? Visa Direct is one of Visa’s fastest‑growing capabilities, enabling real‑time money movement across the globe and powering some of the most innovative payment experiences in the market. We are on a transformation journey — building on strong foundations to deliver simpler, more consistent, and more memorable experiences for our clients. As part of this evolution, we are rethinking how we position, enable, and scale Visa Direct globally, ensuring our teams show up with clarity, confidence, and impact at every client interaction. The Global Sales Enablement team plays a critical role in this journey, shaping how Visa Direct is positioned, launched, and adopted worldwide. We are also embracing the AI revolution to change how we build enablement at scale — from how content is created and personalized, to how insights are generated and applied — with the ultimate goal of improving how clients experience Visa Direct. If you’re passionate about payments technology, and modern enablement, and want to help define the next chapter of how Visa Direct shows up in the market, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a dynamic, global environment. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, storytelling, and scale — helping shape how Visa Direct is understood, experienced, and chosen by clients around the world. The Role At Visa Direct, Sales Enablement sits within Marketing and focuses on equipping Sales and Account Management teams with the messaging, content, tools, and knowledge they need to effectively position our solutions, engage clients, and progress opportunities through the sales lifecycle. This role does not own sales targets or business development activities; instead, it partners closely with Product Marketing, Commercialization, Product, and Sales Leadership to translate strategy into consistent, sales‑ready execution at scale. We are looking for a Sales Enablement Marketing Manager to join the Visa Direct Sales Enablement team. This role is ideal for someone with 6-10 years of experience in sales enablement or related fields who wants to deepen expertise in a global, high-growth payments environment. You’ll partner closely with Product Marketing, Commercialization, Product, and Sales Leadership to translate strategy into execution, turning positioning into practical, sales-ready materials that drive pipeline and revenue. Reporting to a senior member of the team, you will play a key role in improving how we show up in the market and increase our ability to help create pipeline and convert it into revenue. What You’ll Do: Translate Visa Direct strategy, product positioning, and market insights into clear, compelling sales narratives that ensure consistent positioning across regions and segments. Own and evolve a global sales enablement program, standardizing sales‑ready assets (including pitch decks, talk tracks, and product overviews) and governing a centralized content library to support effective, real‑world selling. Enable sales and account teams on core messaging, product updates, and market dynamics, driving adoption of standardized tools and approaches into day‑to‑day sales activities. Partner closely with Product Marketing, Commercialization, Product, and Sales leadership to align positioning, go‑to‑market priorities, and enablement execution. Act as a connector across Product, Marketing, and Sales to define success metrics, gather feedback, and continuously refine enablement content and programs. Identify gaps across the sales lifecycle and drive improvements in consistency, effectiveness, helping pipeline progression. Leverage AI tools and prompting techniques to scale content creation, personalization, insight generation, and seller productivity. Support global and regional teams with enablement materials and insights, ensuring learnings are shared effectively across the organization. Champion innovation and adaptability, taking ownership of evolving priorities and strategic projects that strengthen Visa Direct’s market presence. Key Internal Partners: Global Product Marketing Customer Growth Integrated Marketing, Field Marketing Commercialization Sales / Regional Leaders Product This is a hybrid position. jobs.title: Group Product Manager
jobs.description: About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description The Group Product Manager role sits within Visa Direct’s Currencycloud product and is responsible for leading a tribe (a distinct product area consisting of a group of teams) that builds the infrastructure powering how money moves globally. You’ll help businesses send, receive and manage funds across borders quickly, cheaply, and with full transparency and control. Money movement sits at the heart of how businesses and consumers operate, so the work your tribe does has real, measurable impact. You’ll own the tribe’s product strategy and direction, working across multiple teams and product areas to ensure you are solving the most important problems for customers and the business. You’ll turn company and platform strategy into a clear set of bets, roadmaps and outcomes for your tribe, and create the context and alignment for teams to execute effectively. You’ll directly line manage Product Managers, giving fast feedback, helping them grow, and building a high-performing product team. You’ll work closely with enginee ring, commercial, operations, marketing and other leaders to shape priorities, manage trade-offs, and ensure the tribe is set up to succeed. This role requires a blend of strategic thinking, deep market and customer understanding, and strong leadership. It reports to a Product Director or Senior Director. Responsibilities: Strategy and vision: Develop and communicate the product strategy for your tribe, aligned with company and platform goals. Lead market, customer, competitor and technology analysis to identify opportunities, risks and strategic bets for the tribe. Build alignment and secure buy-in for the tribe’s strategy and roadmap with stakeholders and senior leaders, clearly presenting trade-offs on behalf of teams and the wider tribe. Work with Product Managers to translate strategic goals into clear roadmaps and backlogs, ensuring teams are focused on the highest-impact problems. Discovery: Act as the accountable product lead for large, cross-tribe discovery initiatives, especially where the problem spans multiple teams or domains. Guide discovery approaches across the tribe so teams are consistently uncovering real problems, unmet needs and meaningful opportunities. Support and train PMs and POs on discovery best practices, helping them use data and customer insight to separate signal from noise. Ensure the most important insights and learnings are shared, understood and acted on across the tribe. Delivery: Oversee the end-to-end delivery of critical initiatives within the tribe, from shaping and prioritization through to launch. Work with engineering and delivery leaders to make sure the tribe’s roadmap is realistic, well-sequenced and delivered to a high standard. Help remove cross-team blockers, manage dependencies and adjust plans when needed to keep the tribe moving at pace. Set expectations for quality, reliability and ways of working, and ensure teams are consistently meeting them. Adoption and impact: Partner with Product Marketing and GTM teams on go-to-market strategy, positioning and launches for major tribe initiatives and help to drive best practices for PMs. Drive adoption and usage of your tribe’s products across regions, segments and use cases. Define and track key metrics for your tribe, and use data, customer feedback and commercial insight to refine strategy and roadmap. Make sure the impact of what the tribe ships is clearly understood and communicated, and that learnings feed back into future plans. Leadership, people and tribe management: Line manage Product Managers in the tribe, owning the performance of your team, including hiring and growing great people, tackling underperformance quickly and fairly, and giving regular feedback to build a high-performing team. Create clarity and alignment across multiple teams and functions, especially when working on cross-tribe or platform-wide initiatives. Build strong relationships with stakeholders and peers, advocating for your tribe’s priorities and securing the resources needed to deliver them. Help shape how the tribe operates: ways of working, rituals, standards for product craft, and how teams collaborate. What success looks like A clear, well-understood tribe strategy and roadmap, with stakeholders and teams aligned on where you are heading. The tribe consistently delivering high-impact initiatives that drive measurable outcomes for customers and the business. Product areas within the tribe gaining adoption, performing well and improving over time. PMs in the tribe growing in confidence, capabili ty and imp act, with you seen as a trusted leader and coach. Strong cross-functional collaboration and a tribe that is seen as high-performing, reliable and easy to work with. This is a hybrid position based in London Paddington office. This requires 3 days per week (Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays) attendance in the London office. Qualifications Preferred Qualifications: ​ You don’t need to tick every box to apply, but this role will be a strong fit if you have most of the following: Typically, 5–7+ years’ experience in product roles (e.g. Product Manager, Senior Product Manager, Product Lead or Group Product Manager), ideally in fintech or a tech-led company. Proven ability to craft and communicate product strategy and roadmaps using market research, customer insights, competitive analysis and data. Experience managing and coaching Product Managers. Strong prioritization and product judgement, with a track record of making clear trade-offs and data-informed decisions. Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing decision-making at multiple levels. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to convey complex ideas clearly and succinctly. Ideally, experience in fintech domains such as payments, FX, transaction banking or trading. Personal Qualities High agency and a strong bias to action: you create momentum at tribe level, not just within a single team. Strong people leadership skills, with the ability to inspire, set clear expectations, and give fast, honest feedback. Analytical and commercially sharp, focused on driving meaningful outcomes for customers and the business. Comfortable challenging the status quo, simplifying complexity and making pragmatic decisions in ambiguous situations. Clear and confident communicator, able to tailor messages for different audiences, including executive stakeholders. Structured and organized, with strong attention to detail, while keeping a firm grip on the bigger picture. Intentional about culture: you care about how work gets done, not just what gets delivered. A Platform team, developing and maintaining the scalable foundations that help Product teams move faster.

• Problem solver: You are a pragmatic and product-driven engineer, with an interest in solving problems and delivering value to customers;
• Impact maker: You want to help build an innovative product used by tens of thousands of users and leave your mark;
• Quality-driven: You follow best practices regarding code quality, testing, and code reviews;
• Curiosity: You are a curious and open-minded engineer eager to learn;
• Team player: You have good communication skills, are comfortable working in a team, and can easily work with non-technical colleagues;

jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer for AI Product
jobs.description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).
Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,600+ Qontoers serving over 600,000+ customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.
Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.
AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Join us as a Staff Machine Learning Engineer on our AI Product team to build and ship customer-facing AI for 600,000+ business customers. You'll combine Generative AI with proven machine-learning techniques to create products with measurable impact — adoption, faster task completion, user satisfaction — while ensuring reliability, privacy, and continuous monitoring in production.
➡️ What you'll do
Develop ML models end-to-end: From understanding product requirements to training, evaluating, and deploying models in production. You design, iterate, and ship — not just prototype.
Integrate ML into the product ecosystem: Align with Product Managers, Data Engineers, and Backend Engineers to ensure your models are seamlessly embedded in Qonto's financial services.
Build the ML Ops framework: Create the infrastructure for the team to scale — model drift detection, performance tracking, automated retraining pipelines, monitoring, and alerts.
Put models into production with rigour: Robust technical implementation, quality assurance, and continuous monitoring. Client-facing AI in financial services has no room for silent failures.
Raise the bar for the team: Share best practices, contribute to internal tooling improvements, and mentor peers across the ML team.
➡️ What we're looking for
6+ years as an ML Engineer with ML Ops experience: You've developed and deployed client-facing ML products end-to-end — not internal tools or dashboards. You can show measurable impact on real users.
Modelling expertise: Experience building and optimising machine learning models for external customers. You know when to use GenAI and when proven ML techniques are the better choice.
Strong Python engineering: You write resilient, testable code at scale. Proficient with FastAPI (or similar), third-party service integration, and database interaction in production.
ML Ops fluency: Familiar with tools that automate model retraining, performance checking, and drift detection. You've built or significantly improved ML infrastructure before.
Fluent in English: Qonto's working language.
➡️ What we can offer you
Customer-facing AI with real impact: Your models will be used directly by hundreds of thousands of business customers. You'll see adoption metrics, not just offline evaluations.
A modern, flexible stack: Python, Snowflake, Kafka, Kibana, PostgreSQL, Airflow, AWS, Prometheus, ArgoCD, GitHub, Cursor. You have the freedom to test any tool as long as it helps reach the target.
A team building AI at the core of fintech: 10 AI Engineers and 3 Data Ops working on innovative solutions at the heart of Qonto's financial services — not a side project.
Clear IC growth track: Individual contributor career path for those who want to become deep experts in their field, with access to the latest AI technologies.
➡️ Your future manager
Option A
Your manager will be Marianne Borzic Ducournau, Head of Data Products.
Her background? A graduate of École Polytechnique, Marianne went on to lead Data Science teams at Uber and Amazon in San Francisco before joining Qonto four years ago to build our Data Science team from scratch — hiring the founding members and defining the technical direction.
What does she bring to the team? A rare combination of applied ML expertise and business context from Finance — she helps people see both the technical and the strategic side of what they're building.

Option B
Your manager will be Benjamin Wolter, Head of AI Products.
His background? After earning his PhD in Physics and leading ML Engineering and Data Science teams across last-mile logistics and digital marketing, Benjamin joined Qonto to lead our AI Products team.
What does he bring to the team? Deep technical ML expertise, practical experience building scalable ML systems, and a management style built around ownership and autonomy — he creates the conditions for people to grow without hand-holding.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager [Accounting expertise] - German speaking 🇩🇪
jobs.description:
Join us as a Product Manager to build the accounting products that will make Qonto the default finance workspace for SMEs across Germany and beyond.
You'll own our accounting expansion in the German market end-to-end — shaping the product strategy, deepening our local offering, and defining what we build next — in one of the most fragmented and locally complex domains in fintech: German accounting, bookkeeping, and the DATEV ecosystem.
You will report to Paul Mourot, Head of Product for Accounting.

➡️ What you'll do
Own your product roadmap end-to-end: Define what we build, why, and in what order — working with engineers, designers, and domain experts to ship features that make a real difference for SMEs and their accountants in Germany.
Go deep on German accounting workflows and develop a sharp understanding of how accounting actually works in Germany.
Define and execute the German accounting strategy by understanding customer needs, evaluating what to build vs. partner on, and shaping an offer that's genuinely useful to German SMEs, not just a localized version of what works elsewhere.
Ship faster with AI: Use AI tools (Dust, Notion AI, Claude) and leverage AI as a product lever, identifying where automation and intelligence can transform accounting from a chore into a competitive advantage.
Challenge the status quo: Question assumptions, prototype fast, and push for the best possible product.
Work with maximum squad autonomy: Your squad owns its roadmap, picks its approaches, and ships independently. No layers of approval, no waiting on committees.

➡️ What we're looking for
Deep German accounting domain expertise as you've worked at or closely with a German accounting-tech company.
Concrete examples of products you took from 0 to 1 or significantly scaled. You think in outcomes, not features, and you're comfortable making hard trade-offs.
AI-native workflow: You use AI to supercharge how you work — from research and analysis to spec writing and user testing. You see AI as a product lever, not just a productivity hack.
German fluency, strong English: You're able to navigate the German market natively — accounting is intensely local, and firsthand understanding of the landscape matters. Strong English is required to work cross-functionally across Qonto's European teams.

➡️ What we can offer you
A market being completely transformed: You'll be building Qonto's accounting offer in this market from the ground up and shaping the strategy.
Squad autonomy as the default: You own your decisions and ship without red tape. No committees, no approval chains.
Unlimited access to the best AI tools: Claude, Dust, Notion AI, Cursor, Copilot — every tool you need, no permission required.

➡️ Your future manager
Your manager will be Paul Mourot, Head of Product for Accounting.
His path? Paul was CPO and co-founder at Semana (3+ years), Head of Product at BCG Digital Ventures, and CPO at Tiime — an accounting-tech platform — for nearly 4 years. Before that, he led product at AppTurbo, managing a team of designers, data analysts, and POs. He joined Qonto in 2025 to build the accounting product line. He knows the accounting domain from the inside, he's built products for it before.
What does he bring to the team? Real ownership for his PMs. You define the vision for your scope and you're accountable for the results. His approach: hire great people, give them context and autonomy, and create an environment where the best ideas win.

revenue, collaborating with our internal Affiliate and Marketing team;</li> <li>Use data analysis to spot business opportunities and presenting custom sales presentations with relevant findings and research;</li> <li>Create case studies and best practices regularly, and share them internally and externally with the goal of scaling your account management activities and improve our sales conversion;</li> <li>Test new approaches to increase Total Transaction Volume and Revenue and provide weekly forecast to your manager;</li> <li>Be an advocate for your merchants with internal stakeholders with the goal of improving our business model, integrations, products and services;</li> <li>Meet your merchants face-to-face regularly via on-site visits, fairs, events, and other field activities (traveling time will account for at least 30% of the role); </li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong business acumen;</li> <li>Proven ability to grow partnerships;</li> <li>Proven experience in upselling and cross selling to maximize Merchants  portfolios Total Transaction Volume;</li> <li>Excellent communication skills; proactive, organized and data-driven profile;</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to manage concurrent multiple projects and execute on tight deadlines;</li> <li>Proficiency in Italian, and English is a must;</li> <li>If you speak MEDDIC, it’s a plus;</li> <li>2/3 years experience in account management and/or business consultant.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Hiring process</strong></p> <ol> <li>A quick chat with one of our Talent jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description: <p><strong>This is Adyen</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.</span></p> <p><strong>Account Manager</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a proactive and adaptable Account Manager to join our team in London. The ideal  candidate is a strategic thinker with a hands-on mentality; someone who is eager to help the world’s  biggest brands grow, and can apply this mindset to help Adyen scale. You are excited to work with a global, multicultural team in a collaborative manner and are a keen problem solver. Your focus will be on delivering an outstanding  customer experience, finding and delivering on new opportunities, and driving mutual success for Adyen and our  customers. </p> <p>Our Account Managers are encouraged to challenge each other and sharpen ideas as a team, because  winning is more important than ego. In this role, you’ll get your energy from working on a wide portfolio of  accounts across a variety of verticals. You’ll work alongside a group of talented and driven Account Managers, and together, you’ll develop customer relationships and drive commercial growth for your accounts. </p> <p><strong>Why you should join the Adyen Account Management team:</strong></p> <p>At Adyen, the Account Management (AM) team is critical to the growth and success of our business, as well as  expanding the Adyen brand across the globe. As part of our Account Management team, you’ll manage relationships with innovative international merchants, covering multiple industries and channels.  You’ll have the opportunity to work on cross-functional initiatives and projects in a fast-paced, highly entrepreneurial environment with high autonomy. You’ll become an expert in the global payments  landscape and level up your skills through our AM Academy. </p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaboration: As an Account Manager, you will work closely with your team and collaborate on many different accounts, as well as working individually with your own strategic merchants;</li> <li>Relationship management: Build trust and long-term partnerships with merchants to reduce churn and maximize account value;</li> <li>Commercial acumen: Proactively spot growth opportunities and drive commercial discussions with our merchants, to help grow their accounts and meet financial targets;</li> <li>Project management: Prioritize and manage short and long term projects with varying timelines  across multiple accounts, leveraging internal support teams where relevant;</li> <li>Feedback: Act as a voice of the customer within the business, providing feedback that helps improve both product and merchant experience;</li> <li>Independently manage and prioritise tasks to meet project deadlines with minimal supervision, while proactively identifying and resolving issues to ensure smooth workflow and consistent delivery of high-quality results.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are: </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 3-6 years of experience in a client-facing and commercial role, either on the merchant side or in complex enterprise software, technical infrastructure, or financial services;</li> <li>Enjoy engaging with others and developing strong working relationships internally and externally with  customers;</li> <li>You're a self-starter with a curious mindset. You challenge yourself to go beyond the obvious and use your knowledge to drive customer growth;</li> <li>Motivated by team commercial targets, with a proven track record of finding, driving and delivering growth within an existing portfolio;</li> <li>You have experience in presenting, negotiating, and structuring complex pricing models;</li> <li>You’re highly organized, with excellent time management skills and a constant drive to improve team efficiency;</li> <li>You have full professional written and verbal proficiency in English (other languages are a plus).     </li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments </strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!</span></p> <p><strong>What’s next?</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. </span><a href="https://careers.adyen.com/how-we-hire"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Learn more about our hiring process here</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.</span></p> <p>This role is based out of our London office (3x in the office, 2x WFH). We do not offer remote-only roles.</p>

jobs.description:
About us:
We are a community of visionary innovators, dedicated to providing pioneering software and consultancy services to financial institutions, trading firms, central banks, governments, and corporations around the world. We strive to simplify the way people work. We do that by providing workflow and process automation software, as well as providing real-time data and business intelligence to help people make better decisions. We are 13,000+ employees, we operate globally with 60+ global offices, and we serve over 4,800+ customers worldwide.

For the strengthening of the Payable function within Cedacri companies, part of ION Group, we are looking for talented professionals to grow their career as Accounts Payable Specialist. This position is targeted at candidates with 2–4 years of relevant experience in Accounts Payable. Selected candidates will be placed in a dynamic and innovative environment and will collaborate with cross-functional teams to support the company’s liquidity, funding, and cash management activities
Learn more at iongroup.com. 
Your role:
Your key duties and responsibilities
Process and verify incoming invoices, ensuring accuracy and compliance with internal policies and tax regulations
Reconcile vendor statements and resolve discrepancies in timely manner
Assist in month-end and year-end closing activities related to accounts payable
Collaborate with internal departments (e.g., Procurement, Treasury, Accounting) to ensure smooth operations
Support audits by providing documentation and explanations related to payables
Contribute to the improvement of AP processes and ERP system functionalities
Contribute to the administrative management of the purchase order

Other duties
 You may be asked to support additional finance-related tasks as your role evolves.

Your skills, experience, and qualifications required
Master’s degree in Accounting and Finance (with honors)
2–4 years of experience in Accounts Payable or general accounting
Familiarity with ERP systems (SAP preferred)
Strong knowledge of Italian and international accounting principles and VAT regulations
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Office tools
Accuracy, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities
Good communication skills and a collaborative mindset
Fluency in Italian and good knowledge of English
Availability of travel to the company location in Emilia-Romagna on a weekly basis

What we offer:
Permanent employment contract
Italian National Collective Labour Agreement for the Metalworking Industry (CCNL Metalmeccanico)
Gross Annual Salary (RAL) ranging from €35,000 to €45,000, depending on experience, skills, and qualifications
Job grade B2
Opportunity to join a leading international technology group operating in the financial services industry
Exposure to senior stakeholders activities in a dynamic and growing environment

Location:
Milan

Important notes:
According to the Italian Law (L.68/99) please note that candidates from the disability list will be given priority.

You will review submissions to ensure comprehensive and accurate information is presented to the market, while devising placing strategies and identifying effective product layering to meet client demands and needs. Working with underwriters to place insurance that balances quality, coverage, and price will be a key aspect of your responsibilities. Additionally, you will review wordings and gather market intelligence to ensure our product offering remains up to date and relevant. Developing strong relationships with markets and providing broking guidance and support for junior team members will be vital to your success. The ability to work independently, use initiative, and meet tight deadlines, showcasing your self-motivation and time management skills. The Role To provide strategic leadership, technical oversight and operational direction across the Property and Casualty claims teams, ensuring a consistently high-quality claims service for clients, colleagues and market partners. The role is responsible for developing and implementing claims strategy, best practice and operating principles across these lines of business, ensuring alignment with wider business objectives, regulatory requirements and the overall claims value proposition. The role will support the visibility and profile of the claims function internally and externally, including through client engagement, tender support, market relationship management, thought leadership, using data to drive insights, training and collaboration with placing teams. The Strategic Claims Leader will act as the claims relationship contact for key large accounts, as well as a senior referral point for complex, high-value or sensitive claims matters, supporting colleagues in the effective management, escalation and resolution of claims. The role will also drive continuous improvement across people, process, technology and data, ensuring workloads are managed effectively, capability is developed, and claims insights are used to improve client outcomes and support business growth. The role requires a senior claims professional with strong technical expertise across Property and Casualty claims, proven leadership capability, commercial judgement, and the ability to operate confidently with clients, markets, senior stakeholders and global colleagues. What you'll do 1. Strategic Planning, Reporting and Business Performance Develop and implement the claims strategy for Property and Casualty claims, ensuring alignment with business priorities, claims operating principles and client service expectations. Contribute to operating plans, business planning and claims leadership discussions, ensuring that claims activity supports wider business goals. Provide high-quality, practical and commercially focused advice to senior stakeholders on claims strategy, service delivery, technical issues, market behaviour and emerging trends. Drive business performance through effective planning, prioritisation and support mechanisms, ensuring delivery of agreed objectives and service standards. Produce and present relevant management information, claims insights and performance updates to senior management, divisional leadership and other stakeholders as required. Lead or contribute to strategic claims projects and operational initiatives, including those involving service improvement, process standardisation, technology adoption, data quality and global claims capability. Ensure that the Property and Casualty claims teams are aligned with the relevant claims operating principles, service expectations and business priorities. 2. Technical Claims Leadership Act as a senior technical referral and escalation point for complex, high-value, contentious or strategically significant Property and Casualty claims. Provide expert oversight of claims handling strategy, ensuring that claims are investigated, evaluated, negotiated and resolved in a timely, commercial and client-focused manner. Support colleagues on larger or more complex accounts and claims, ensuring that the client’s needs are understood and effectively met. Review and advise on relevant claims documentation, coverage issues, insurer positions, market responses and negotiation strategy where appropriate. Support the presentation of complex claims to insurers and underwriters, ensuring that appropriate information, feedback and updates are provided to clients, insurers and internal stakeholders. Identify opportunities for proactive claims advocacy and ensure that claims strategies are aligned with client objectives, policy coverage and market dynamics. Ensure appropriate processes are in place for claims escalation, technical referral, file quality, peer review and consistent decision-making. Remain informed of relevant legal, regulatory, market and technical developments affecting Property and Casualty claims, ensuring that the team’s technical capability remains current and credible. 3. Client, Market and Business Development Support Promote a clear and compelling claims value proposition for Property and Casualty clients, both internally and externally. Support the sales process and client offering through involvement in tenders, prospect meetings, renewals, client reviews and placing team discussions. Work closely with account executives, brokers, placing teams and client-facing colleagues to ensure that claims considerations are integrated into client strategy, coverage discussions, renewals and wider client management. Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, insurers, loss adjusters, lawyers, experts and other market participants. Monitor market behaviour in relation to claims, including insurer responsiveness, coverage positions, negotiation trends and claims service standards, and provide feedback through relevant claims and divisional forums. Attend and present at client, insurer and market meetings as required, supporting business development and client retention objectives. Identify claims trends, legal developments, coverage themes and market issues that may be relevant to clients, placing teams and senior management. Contribute to the development of claims brochures, client-facing materials, tender content and other offering documents for Property and Casualty claims. 4. Operational Excellence, Process and Governance Drive a consistent, high-quality and efficient claims service across Property and Casualty claims. Review and improve claims processes, procedures and workflows to ensure they are effective, proportionate, compliant and aligned with agreed service levels. Ensure appropriate governance, documentation and communication standards are maintained across the teams. Monitor workloads and resource allocation, ensuring the strategic use of talent, technology and location to deliver measurable efficiencies and sustainable service delivery. Support the adoption of technology, claims systems and data-led processes that improve service, visibility, consistency and operational control. Ensure that claims records are accurate, complete and maintained in accordance with Group requirements, regulatory obligations and internal procedures. Support internal and external audit activity as required, ensuring that claims processes, controls and records are fit for purpose. Identify operational risks, process gaps and service issues, and ensure that appropriate remediation or improvement plans are implemented. 5. Data, Insight and Thought Leadership Lead the use of claims data and insights across Property and Casualty claims to inform decision-making, client discussions, market engagement and business planning. Work with data, analytics and operational teams to improve data quality, reporting and the effective presentation of claims trends and insights. Identify emerging risks, recurring claims themes, insurer behaviours, coverage issues and market developments, translating these into practical insights for clients and colleagues. Contribute to thought leadership and marketing initiatives, including articles, seminars, panel discussions, videos, podcasts, client briefings and internal updates. Develop and deliver training sessions for internal and external audiences, supporting ongoing technical development and awareness of claims issues across the business. Promote knowledge sharing across claims teams and wider business functions to strengthen collective expertise and client service. 6. People Leadership, Talent and Culture Provide visible leadership across the Property and Casualty claims teams, promoting a positive, inclusive, collaborative and high-performing culture. Develop and retain talent through coaching, mentoring, performance management, succession planning and structured development activity. Support team members in building technical capability, commercial judgement, client management skills and market credibility. Identify capability gaps and support recruitment, onboarding and development plans to strengthen claims expertise across the relevant lines of business. Act as a role model for positive leadership behaviours, collaboration, accountability and professional standards. Encourage open communication, knowledge sharing and mutual support across teams and geographies. Work with managers and senior leaders to ensure that performance, HR, training and competence records are maintained in accordance with Group requirements. Support less experienced colleagues on complex matters and contribute to their personal and professional development. 7. Global and Cross-Functional Collaboration Adopt a global perspective across Property and Casualty claims, helping to map claims capabilities, share best practice and strengthen communities of expertise. Collaborate with regional claims teams, placing teams, technical specialists, wordings experts, legal colleagues, data teams and operational functions to ensure a joined-up approach to common issues. Support the development of consistent claims standards, escalation routes, reporting frameworks and client service expectations across geographies. Contribute to global practice objectives and cross-border claims initiatives where relevant. Share information and insight that may benefit the wider business, including market intelligence, claims trends, client feedback and operational lessons learned. 8. Regulatory, Compliance and Professional Standards Ensure compliance with all applicable legal, fiscal, regulatory and operational obligations, including Group policies, procedures and conduct requirements. Maintain accurate records and ensure appropriate authorisation, documentation and communication standards are followed. Ensure that claims activity is undertaken honestly, professionally, fairly and ethically, with appropriate regard to client outcomes and regulatory expectations. Complete all relevant regulatory and mandatory training and ensure ongoing competence to perform the role. Support a culture of operational excellence, risk awareness, good governance and continuous improvement. Keep informed of legal and regulatory developments relevant to the business, the claims function and the Property and Casualty lines of business. Who we're looking for Extensive experience in claims management within the insurance sector, with strong technical expertise in Property and Casualty claims. Proven experience handling or overseeing complex, high-value, contentious or strategically significant claims. Strong understanding of the insurance market, including insurer behaviour, claims negotiation dynamics, coverage issues and client service expectations. Experience working with clients, brokers, insurers, lawyers, loss adjusters, experts and other market participants. Experience supporting business development, tenders, renewals, client meetings and market-facing activity. Experience leading teams, developing talent and creating a positive, collaborative and high-performing team culture. Experience delivering operational improvements, process change, claims governance or claims transformation initiatives. Strong awareness of the regulatory environment and the importance of compliant, ethical and well-governed claims practices. Experience working across multiple jurisdictions, regions or business units would be advantageous. Familiarity with claims data, management information and insight-led decision-making. Strategic thinker with the ability to translate business priorities into clear claims objectives and practical delivery plans. Strong technical claims judgement and the confidence to act as a senior referral point on complex matters. Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills. Strong relationship-building capability, with the ability to engage credibly with clients, markets, senior leaders and colleagues. Commercially focused and client-oriented, with a clear understanding of how claims service supports retention, growth and differentiation. Strong negotiation, advocacy and influencing skills. Analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret claims data, identify trends and convert insight into action. Able to lead through others, build capability and motivate teams. Collaborative, inclusive and able to work effectively across functions, geographies and lines of business. Calm and resilient under pressure, with the ability to manage competing priorities and complex issues. Innovative and improvement-focused, with a positive approach to change, technology and new ways of working. High levels of numeracy, literacy and professional judgement. Committed to continuous learning, knowledge sharing and maintaining technical excellence. Degree-level education or equivalent professional experience. Relevant insurance, claims, legal, risk management or professional qualifications would be advantageous. Continued professional development in claims, insurance, leadership or relevant technical disciplines is expected. What do we offer in return? A career that you define. This isn't just a job - it's an asset that grows year after year. </p> <p><strong>The Financial Blueprint (Partnership bonuses)</strong></p> <p>We are more than just a card reader, you can build and grow your business across offer one of the most competitive commission structures in the payments technology industry:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Upfront Commission:</strong> 50% of the upfront contract value paid immediately upon sign-up (average upfront value per merchant: approx. £500).</li> <li><strong>Lifetime Residuals:</strong> Lifetime Residuals: Earn 25% recurring income from the transaction volume of every merchant you sign, paid monthly for up to 5 years. To support your first 3 months, your residuals are enhanced by up to 3× while you build your portfolio.</li> <li><strong>Hardware & Software Incentives:</strong> Additional direct commission on every card reader sold.</li> <li><strong>Earnings Benchmark:</strong> 40% of our active independent partners consistently earn £7,000+/month. Our top performers are well beyond that.</li> </ul> <p><em>Note: This is a 100% commission-only, self-employed role. There is no basic salary. Your financial outcome is entirely a reflection of your drive, discipline, and sales competence.</em></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Your Daily Operation</strong></p> <p>The most successful Sales Partners do not wait for opportunities - they create them. Here is what building your business looks like week to week:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Fearless Prospector:</strong> Prospecting a minimum of 30 local SMEs every day through face-to-face visits and outbound outreach - retailers, restaurants, cafes, beauty salons, and beyond.</li> <li><strong>Consultative Selling:</strong> Analysing each merchant's current payment setup, identifying genuine pain points, and presenting SumUp's full ecosystem - payments, POS, and operations - as the superior long-term solution.</li> <li><strong>Pipeline & Territory Management:</strong> Owning your designated territory while recognising you're free to generate business anywhere in the UK. Planning your sales week independently, managing your CRM, and progressing merchants from initial conversation through to hardware installation and onboarding.</li> <li><strong>Meaningful Conversations:</strong> Creating at least three real sales conversations every day and converting them into 3-5 new merchant partnerships every week.</li> <li><strong>Relationship Building:</strong> Becoming the recognised payments expert within your local business community - the person SME owners call first.</li> </ul> <p><em>Consistency creates momentum. Momentum creates freedom.</em></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Launch Your Business Properly</strong></p> <p>Every entrepreneur starts somewhere. Your journey begins with a dedicated full-time training week where you will learn everything you need - the product, the pitch, objection handling, CRM, and territory strategy - to build your business with confidence from day one.</p> <p>After that, you are in control of your diary, your pipeline, and your future - with ongoing coaching from experienced field sales leaders who are invested in your success. We also offer appointments to our most committed partners as your relationship with SumUp develops.</p> <p>You will never build alone. SumUp gives you the credibility, technology, product range, and support of one of the world's fastest-growing fintech companies - so you can focus entirely on what matters: winning merchants and building your portfolio.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Critical Requirements - Who We Are Looking For</strong></p> <p>This is a high-reward role designed for resilient, self-directed sales professionals. You will only succeed here if you meet the following:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Proven Track Record:</strong> Experience in high-rejection, face-to-face or B2B sales environments - field sales, door-to-door, telecoms, energy broking, merchant services, or similar.</li> <li><strong>The Hunter Mindset:</strong> You do not wait for leads. You love the cold approach. You possess advanced objection-handling skills and treat every "no" as data, not defeat.</li> <li><strong>Financial Resilience:</strong> You understand self-employment and have the financial stability to bridge an initial pipeline-building phase before residuals begin compounding.</li> <li><strong>Self-Discipline:</strong> You operate entirely self-directed. You do not need daily management, corporate supervision, or external motivation to show up and perform.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Awareness:</strong> You understand what a recurring revenue asset is worth and can articulate that value to a business owner in plain English.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Who This Role is NOT For</strong></p> <ul> <li>Individuals seeking a secure monthly base salary or corporate benefits package.</li> <li>Account managers who prefer managing existing relationships over new business acquisition.</li> <li>Candidates looking for a relaxed entry-level position or structured customer service environment.</li> <li>Anyone who has not operated in a commission-driven, self-generated pipeline role before.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Ready to Build Your Own Commercial Portfolio?</strong></p> <p>If you have the drive, the resilience, and the B2B sales experience to back it up - and you want to build something that pays you long after the sale is made - we want to hear from you.</p> <p>Apply now to submit your profile and schedule an introductory call with our partner team. Let's talk numbers.</p> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Job Application Tip</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.</span></p></div>
