jobs.title: Field Sales Territory Manager
jobs.description: <p><strong>About Us: </strong>SumUp is a leading financial technology company that empowers small businesses to succeed in a digital world. Over 4 million businesses rely on SumUp to get paid. Our innovative point-of-sale (POS) and card reader solutions provide seamless payment processing, inventory management, and business analytics, enabling merchants to focus on what they do best. With a range of in-house solutions, from best-in-class card readers and point-of-sale software to other services such as kiosks, business accounts, invoicing software, and lending services, Sumup is a one-stop digital partner for today’s growing small merchants.</p> <p><strong>Role Description and What is Expected: </strong>This commission-based role requires individuals who are passionate about sales, driven to succeed, and have a proven track record of exceeding targets. As a self-employed Field Sales Consultant at SumUp, you will have the opportunity to earn uncapped commission by building relationships with UK small businesses and helping them understand the value Sumup products can drive. With our expansive product toolkit, you can act as a solutions consultant and offer all solutions in-house. </p> <p><strong>What you’ll do: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify and engage high-potential clients within your designated territory, focusing on small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs).</li> <li>Conduct compelling face-to-face meetings and deliver persuasive product demonstrations to showcase the benefits of SumUp's cutting-edge Card reader and POS solutions.</li> <li>Effectively communicate our products' value proposition and unique selling points, addressing client needs and objections with finesse.</li> <li>Proactively generate leads and build a robust sales pipeline through networking, referrals, and other targeted activities</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your profile:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrated success in a field sales role, ideally from the hospitality and retail industry or other point-of-sale solutions</li> <li>Proven ability to consistently exceed sales targets & deliver outstanding results.</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and foster long-term client relationships.</li> <li>In-depth knowledge of your market and a genuine passion for supporting local SMBs.</li> <li>Experience with outbound lead generation, cold calling or building lead pipelines.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Uncapped commission structure, providing unlimited earning potential based on your performance.</li> <li>Comprehensive training and ongoing professional development opportunities to enhance your sales skills and product knowledge</li> <li>The chance to run your own business and be a CEO of your company.</li> </ul> <p>If you are an exceptional sales professional who thrives in a commission-based environment, we want to hear from you! Join our dynamic team at SumUp and embark on a rewarding sales career where your success knows no limits.</p> <p><strong>The recruitment Process:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Introductory Pre-Selection meeting with our Talent Acquisition Partner</li> <li>Technical interview with the Head of Field Sales </li> </ul> <p class="css-v01gqo"><strong>About SumUp:</strong></p> <p class="css-v01gqo">We believe in the everyday hero. Small business owners are at the heart of all we do, so we're creating tools that help them run their businesses. With a founder’s mentality and a 'team-first' attitude, our diverse teams across Europe, South America, and the United States work together to ensure that the small business owners we partner with can be successful doing what they love.</p> <p class="css-v01gqo">SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.</p> <p class="css-v01gqo">SumUp will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Job Application Tip</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.</span></p></div>

jobs.title: Field Sales Trainer (UK South)
jobs.description: <p>📍 <strong>London, office-first </strong>| 🕐 <strong>12-month fixed-term contract (with possibility of extension)</strong> </p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>Our Sales Training team is a group of highly engaged and commercially minded trainers, working across Europe to make sure every field sales representative has the knowledge, skills, and confidence to succeed from day one. In the UK, we're growing fast — and the quality of that growth matters just as much as the pace. This role sits at the heart of that ambition: you'll be the person who turns new hires into active, high-performing field reps, and helps existing reps keep raising the bar. If you're someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, takes ownership without being asked, and genuinely cares about the impact of great training, this is a role worth getting excited about.</p> <p>You’ll have the opportunity to shape how Field Sales Representatives are trained, supported, and activated across the UK — with a direct impact on their early success and on the growth of the business.</p> <h2> </h2> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Deliver engaging onboarding for up to 60 new field sales representatives per month through a blend of live workshops and self-directed content, taking ownership of their readiness from day one</li> <li>Lead role-play assessments and accreditations to evaluate sales readiness, provide constructive feedback, and ensure new hires are equipped to make their first sale</li> <li>Track activation rates and new joiner performance data to measure the commercial impact of training, identify gaps early and take action to improve outcomes</li> <li>Partner with the existing UK Field Sales Trainer and Training Team Lead to design and continuously improve programmes that drive sales volume, quality, and multi-product adoption</li> <li>Work closely with Territory Managers, recruiters, and Sales Enablement to share insights on candidate readiness, onboarding engagement, and early performance— and use those insights to improve what comes next</li> </ul> <h2> </h2> <h2><strong>You'll be great for this role if…</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Excellent facilitation, coaching, and feedback skills, with the ability to engage people with different levels of experience</li> <li>Proven experience delivering live and virtual sales training, including role-play facilitation and accreditation sessions</li> <li>Ability to connect training initiatives directly to commercial outcomes such as activation rates, rep performance, and sales results, and take ownership of those numbers</li> <li>Experience creating and adapting training materials, including assessments and self-directed content, that hold up in a fast-moving, high-volume environment</li> <li>Strong knowledge of digital learning platforms (LMS), sales tools, and blended learning approaches</li> <li>A valid UK driving licence and comfort travelling across the South of the UK to deliver in-person training</li> </ul> <h2> </h2> <h2><strong>Why you should join SumUp</strong></h2> <p>🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our Bankside location, in a culturally rich area that bridges deep history and modern living. This involves an office-first setup </p> <p>🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced</p> <p>🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves</p> <p>📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education</p> <p>🏥 Health matters: private health insurance, including optical and dental</p> <p>🚗 Life made easier: salary-sacrifice commuter benefits via Gogeta</p> <p>💼 Financial security: retirement scheme (SumUp matches 7% when you contribute 5%)</p> <p>🛡 Peace of mind: life insurance from MetLife for 2× your salary</p> <p>🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service</p> <p>🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team</p> <h2> </h2> <h2><strong>About SumUp</strong></h2> <p>Be empowered to do more that matters.</p> <p>At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.</p> <p>Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in<a href="https://youtu.be/9DG64C3moeQ?si=YpcWuBNBTOQPzeLI"> our diverse team</a> of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset.<a href="https://www.sumup.com/careers/culture/"> Our core values</a> lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.</p> <p>SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. jobs.description: <h1><strong>Head of Consumer Growth</strong></h1> <p>SumUp is building a consumer financial product with a distribution advantage that almost no other fintech can replicate.</p> <p>More than four million merchants use SumUp, and more than a billion consumers come into contact with our products each year. We now have the opportunity to turn that reach into one of the world’s largest consumer financial ecosystems.</p> <p>Our consumer product is already live across six European markets. The next challenge is to grow it from an emerging proposition into a product used by millions of consumers and this role will lead that journey.</p> <p>As <strong>Head of Consumer Growth</strong>, you will own the go-to-market strategy, commercial growth plan and acquisition engine for SumUp’s consumer product. You will build the consumer growth function from its current early stage, bringing together performance marketing, direct-to-consumer acquisition, merchant-led distribution, CRM, creative and content.</p> <p>You will combine proven consumer growth channels with an opportunity unique to SumUp: turning our merchant network and consumer touchpoints into a powerful new route to market. GTM roadmap, ensuring product launches, propositions and campaigns are coordinated across channels and markets.</li> <li>Partner closely with Product, Brand, Communications and SumUp’s wider GTM performance, investment decisions and the trade-offs required to scale.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You’ll be great for this role if you have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A strong track record of leading leading multidisciplinary growth teams while remaining comfortable operating hands-on.</li> <li>Strong commercial judgement and a track record of making effective investment decisions under uncertainty.</li> <li>The ability to work across Product, Brand, Analytics, Communications and local market teams within a complex organisation.</li> <li>A rigorous experimentation mindset and the creativity or pace.</li> </ul> <p>This is an opportunity to build more than a marketing team. jobs.title: Senior iOS Engineer
jobs.description: <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>At SumUp, we're on a mission to bring merchants and consumers closer together and help local communities thrive. With <strong>SumUp Consumer</strong>, we're building a rewarding banking experience that connects people to the small businesses they love while enabling free transactions for our merchants.</p> <p>SumUp Consumer helps consumers manage their money with ease and get more from everyday spending. It offers seamless payment experiences and financial tools designed for modern life—spanning banking, cards, savings, and open banking.</p> <p>This is a high-impact, hands-on engineering role where you'll own the development and quality of the <strong>SumUp Consumer iOS application</strong>. You'll work directly on the features that consumers interact with every day, collaborating closely with Backend Engineers, Product Managers, Designers, and Android Engineers to deliver polished, reliable, and impactful mobile experiences.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Build and ship features</strong> across key consumer banking product areas—including KYC flows, card management, savings, open banking consent, and payment experiences.</li> <li><strong>Write clean, testable Swift code</strong> and participate actively in code reviews to uphold high engineering standards across the codebase.</li> <li><strong>Contribute to and evolve the iOS app architecture</strong>, including modularisation, dependency management, and scalability patterns as the product grows.</li> <li><strong>Own performance and reliability</strong> by monitoring crash rates, proactively identifying issues, and driving app stability before they impact consumers.</li> <li><strong>Maintain a culture of quality</strong> by writing unit and UI tests and contributing to the health of our CI/CD pipelines.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate cross-functionally</strong> with Backend Engineers on API design, Product Managers on roadmap priorities, and Designers on seamless user experiences.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What makes you great for this position</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong proficiency in <strong>Swift</strong> and deep knowledge of the iOS framework (Objective-C knowledge is a plus).</li> <li>Solid understanding of <strong>RESTful API integration</strong> and experience working with backend engineers on API design.</li> <li>Experience working with <strong>agile methodologies</strong>, CI/CD pipelines, and pair programming.</li> <li>Deep care for user interaction, usability, and interface quality—you build things that feel great to use.</li> <li>Ability to understand a large problem, design a solution, break it into deliverable chunks, and ship it independently.</li> <li>Passion for clean, maintainable, and testable code and a genuine pride in your craft.</li> <li>Mature, business-minded approach—balancing high-quality engineering with pragmatism in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Self-driven and proactive nature, comfortable owning a domain with limited direct oversight.</li> <li>Previous experience in payments, financial services, or fintech environments is a strong plus.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why you should join SumUp</strong></h2> <p>🌎 <strong>Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally</strong> on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide.</p> <p>🌈 <strong>Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:</strong> be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced.</p> <p>🚀 <strong>Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme:</strong> you will own a stake in SumUp’s future success.</p> <p>📚 <strong>A dedicated annual L&D budget</strong> for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advancing your career through further education.</p> <p>💶 <strong>Competitive Health & Life Insurance:</strong> Includes comprehensive cover (optical, dental) and Life Assurance (2 x your salary).</p> <p>💰 <strong>Financial Future:</strong> A corporate pension scheme and a referral bonus for bringing in top talent.</p> <p>🏖️ <strong>Generous time off:</strong> 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days.</p> <p>🌴 <strong>Break4me:</strong> 1-month paid sabbatical after 3 years of service.</p> <p>🎉 <strong>Culture of Connection:</strong> Attend global offsites and/or hackathons with your teammates.</p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>About SumUp</strong></h2> <p>Be empowered to do more that matters. At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing a vast set of simple and affordable business tools to help them start, run, and grow their businesses. Today, over 4 million businesses in 36 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.</p> <p>Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster an inclusivity and continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.</p> <p>SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Job Application Tip</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. jobs.title: Senior Product Data Analyst - Consumer Growth
jobs.description: <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.</p> <p>As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes.</p> <p>You’ll help answer questions such as:</p> <ul> <li>Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value?</li> <li>Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation?</li> <li>What drives repeat usage, retention and churn?</li> <li>Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance?</li> <li>How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments?</li> </ul> <p>If you’re motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence both product decisions and commercial outcomes, this role is for you.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle — from <strong>acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation</strong>.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to improve conversion, customer value and sustainable growth using funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analytics.</li> <li>Collaborate closely questions, translating complex data into clear, commercially relevant recommendations.</li> <li>Define, monitor and communicate core SumUp Consumer KPIs, covering acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, churn and customer value.</li> <li>Design, execute and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer impact and commercial impact.</li> <li>Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that stakeholders actively use, proactively surfacing trends, anomalies, performance risks and growth opportunities.</li> <li>Help Product Managers assess the expected impact of opportunities and evaluate whether product investments are delivering the intended customer and business outcomes.</li> <li>Partner with Analytics Engineering to ensure KPI definitions, business logic and product instrumentation are accurate, scalable and trusted.</li> <li>Bring a curious eye to AI and machine learning techniques, including LLM-assisted analysis, to speed up insight generation, customer understanding and product measurement.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You’ll be great for this role if…</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable querying, analysing and validating data in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or similar.</li> <li>You have hands-on experience with product analytics techniques such as funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analysis.</li> <li>You understand the commercial drivers of a digital product, including customer acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, churn and customer lifetime value.</li> <li>You can connect customer behaviour and product performance to business outcomes, and use data to identify growth opportunities and inform prioritisation.</li> <li>You’ve worked on A/B tests or product experiments, with a solid grounding in the statistics behind them.</li> <li>You’re proficient in a visualisation tool such as Looker, Tableau or Power BI, with a track record of building dashboards that stakeholders actually use.</li> <li>You can translate ambiguous product or business questions into structured analysis, and explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike.</li> <li>You’re comfortable assessing trade-offs, challenging assumptions and making recommendations based on evidence.</li> <li>You’re curious about how AI and emerging techniques can improve product measurement, experimentation, customer understanding and commercial decision-making.</li> <li>You’re comfortable managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders, with strong prioritisation and a proactive communication style.</li> </ul> <p><strong>This role does not support Visa sponsorship and candidates must have the right to jobs.description: <p><strong>SumUp | Product & Design | London, United Kingdom</strong></p> <p><em>Competitive salary · Office-first</em></p> <p><a href="https://youtu.be/uWNyTvZGeew?si=IiJBUDQe8yJpOFwq">Check out our London office 🎥</a></p> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Consumer Bank squad sits at the heart of one of SumUp's most exciting growth bets — scaling SumUp Pay, our consumer fintech product, to millions of active users across Europe. The team owns end-to-end UX and product design across the full user lifecycle, from onboarding and activation through to engagement features like Spaces, Open Banking insights, and budget tracking. This involves an office-first setup</p> <p>🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced</p> <p>🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success</p> <p>🏖️ Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves</p> <p>🏥 Health matters: private health insurance, including optical and dental</p> <p>🚗 Life made easier: salary-sacrifice commuter benefits via Gogeta</p> <p>💼 Financial security: retirement scheme (SumUp matches 7% when you contribute 5%)</p> <p>🛡️ Peace of mind: life insurance from MetLife for 2× your salary</p> <p>🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service</p> <p>🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team</p> <p> </p> <h2>About SumUp</h2> <p>Be empowered to do more that matters.</p> <p>At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. approach, bringing sound judgment to novel user-related questions and helping teams identify practical, sustainable paths forward.</li> <li>Deploy strategically as a subject matter expert to explain apply independently, driving a “compliant by design” approach.</li> <li>Leverage AI and agentic tools to scale user enablement - including accelerating risk assessments, regulatory research, and requirements documentation - while applying rigorous judgment to novel, complex, or precedent-setting decisions and validating AI-generated outputs.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>9+ years of experience building and managing compliance programs in regulated financial services, preferably in fintech, payments, or banking.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of regulatory compliance and financial crimes/AML practices, with an understanding of the risk landscape applicable to a company like Stripe.</li> <li>Proven ability to independently lead multiple complex projects and programs, from ambiguous early questions through implementation.</li> <li>Ability to interpret regulations and regulatory guidance, identify the underlying risks they are intended to address, and translate those requirements into comprehensive, proportionate compliance programs.</li> <li>Experience evaluating complex user requests for compliance risk and working with business stakeholders to implement creative solutions to enable users while meeting compliance requirements</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, cross-functional collaboration skills, including navigating leadership and interpersonal working relationships</li> <li>Intellectual curiosity and comfort operating at the frontier, including exploring unfamiliar markets, product types, and regulatory frameworks.</li> <li>Sound, independent judgment in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment.</li> <li>Genuine interest in financial product innovation and an eagerness to drive the industry forward by building and scaling products responsibly.</li> <li>Demonstrated AI fluency, creativity, and judgment—actively identifies opportunities to solve compliance problems, improve product enablement, and turn repeatable work into scalable solutions. Uses AI to accelerate research, requirements mapping, and routine guidance while maintaining appropriate oversight of AI-generated outputs.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience using AI or agentic tools in a compliance or regulatory context (e.g., for policy drafting, risk assessments, regulatory research, or workflow automation)</li> <li>Experience with stablecoin, crypto, or emerging payments compliance</li> <li>ACAMS, CRCM, ICA (Diploma or Advanced Certificate), or an equivalent certification</li> </ul>

jobs.title: EMEA Chief Compliance Officer

We are open to candidates based in London or Dublin.</span></p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is seeking a highly experienced and strategic Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) to lead our regulatory compliance, financial crimes and enterprise risk officers and program across EMEA. This role reports to the Global Head of Compliance Officers, CROs & MLROs and sits within the Financial Crime, Compliance & Risk Oversight (FinCRO) organization.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong> </h2> <p>You will be the principal decision-maker and strategic lead on financial crimes, regulatory compliance and enterprise risk management for EMEA, serving a critical role in ensuring Stripe's continued safe growth in the region. You will be the public face of the compliance team across EMEA and a primary point of contact with regulators, financial partners, and internal stakeholders. You will provide strategic direction and oversight to the MLROs operating across the region, ensuring programs are designed to efficiently and effectively prevent, detect, and report financial crime. The ideal candidate will have deep subject matter expertise in regulatory compliance, financial crimes and ERM across EMEA markets, and a proven track record forging tech-forward compliance programs in a regulated financial services or payments environment.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Strategic Leadership</strong>: Develop and implement a robust and scalable compliance strategy for EMEA, aligning with global FinCRO objectives and business goals. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">Drive a culture of compliance and sound regulatory risk management across the region as Stripe expands its product offerings in existing markets and enters new ones.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Team Management</strong>: Lead, mentor, and inspire a high-performing team of compliance, risk management and financial crimes professionals across EMEA, fostering a culture of compliance, collaboration, continuous improvement and creative solutioning across a geographically distributed team.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>AML/Financial Crimes Program Oversight</strong>: Own and enhance the regional AML, counter-terrorist financing, sanctions, and anti-bribery and corruption (ABC) programs for EMEA, working closely with MLROs in the region.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Regulatory Management</strong>: Serve as the primary point of contact for financial regulators across EMEA and an ambassador to the industry in the region. Lead regulatory engagement including license applications, new regulatory consultations, and ongoing supervisory relationships. Engage with regulatory bodies on Stripe's behalf and serve as a thought leader for technology-focused compliance solutions. Proactively manage regulatory change, uplifting programs and controls as needed.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Partner and Relationship Management</strong>: Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key financial partners, including banks, payment networks, and other third-party providers. Serve as the senior compliance point of contact for partner inquiries, audits, and ongoing operational alignment across the region.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Advisory and Consultation</strong>: Ensure Stripe's global regulatory compliance, financial crimes and enterprise risk management frameworks, policies, and controls (e.g., KYC, transaction monitoring, regulatory reporting, risk assessment, training, testing) are fit for purpose for local requirements. Monitor product launches and business model changes to ensure regional compliance programs reflect new developments, including timely regulatory notifications. Provide expert guidance to business stakeholders on market expansion, product development, and operational changes to ensure compliance by design.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Governance and Reporting</strong>: Mature the regional governance framework to streamline decision-making and focus oversight on the areas of greatest regulatory and business risk.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</span></p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>12+ years of experience in compliance and financial crime, with significant focus on financial services, fintech, or payments, including direct experience in a senior compliance role in EMEA.</li> <li>Extensive people management experience, including leading geographically dispersed teams through organizational and regulatory change.</li> <li>Deep and current knowledge of regulatory compliance and AML/financial crime requirements across key EMEA markets, with particular expertise with CBI and FCA. </li> <li>Demonstrated experience interacting directly with financial regulators in EMEA, including managing supervisory relationships, license applications, and regulatory change processes.</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex regulatory concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, and to represent Stripe externally with credibility and authority.</li> <li>Ability to think strategically and translate complex regulatory requirements into practical, scalable business solutions in a fast-moving environment.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making and a comfort operating in ambiguity.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist) or other relevant professional certifications are a plus.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Experience working in a global, matrixed organization spanning multiple regulatory regimes.</li> </ul>

jobs.title: Indirect Tax Advisory Consultant
jobs.description: <p><strong>Who we are</strong></p> <p><strong>About Stripe</strong></p> <p>Stripe's mission is to increase the GDP of the internet. We build the most powerful and flexible tools for running an internet business — handling billions of dollars each year and enabling millions of businesses worldwide to scale faster by building on Stripe. Our tax team partners with Stripes across the company to build an efficient, scalable tax structure as we expand into new markets globally.</p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>Our International Indirect Tax Advisory function is responsible for determining the taxability of new products, managing indirect tax audits and relationships with local tax authorities, and partnering with our indirect tax systems and compliance leads on day-to-day matters. We work cross-functionally across finance, product, and engineering — and we're looking for a sharp, collaborative tax professional to join us.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <p>The position is based in Dublin or London and reports to the International Indirect Tax Advisory Lead.</p> <ul> <li>Serve as an indirect tax subject matter expert (global VAT/GST) for Stripe's business and finance teams, managing aspects of our indirect tax planning and operations</li> <li>Support Stripe's international expansion, including advising on new market entry and product launches</li> <li>Participate in policy matters affecting indirect taxes internationally</li> <li>Collaborate with indirect tax compliance leads and international accounting teams on VAT/GST compliance, and contribute to the ongoing enhancement of compliance processes</li> <li>Support the management of indirect tax audits and other matters involving tax authorities internationally</li> <li>Partner with product and engineering teams to define requirements and contribute to the design of tax solutions for our users</li> <li>Drive indirect tax awareness across the business, including training and communication on changes to indirect tax legislation, systems, policies, and processes</li> <li>Communicate complex indirect tax concepts clearly and accessibly to non-tax professionals across all levels of the organisation</li> </ul> <hr> <p><strong>Who you are</strong></p> <p>We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements below. Preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <p><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>4–6 years of relevant indirect tax experience, with strong knowledge of VAT/GST laws and regulations</li> <li>Bachelor's degree and a professional qualification in tax or law (e.g. CTA, ACA, AITI, ATT, or equivalent)</li> <li>Previous in-house experience within a multinational business, combined with legal or accountancy firm experience</li> <li>Experience with indirect taxes as they relate to the distribution of digital services and physical products</li> <li>Accounting experience and proficiency with ERP systems and data analytics tools</li> <li>Strong written and oral communication skills, with the ability to engage clearly with all levels of management</li> <li>Project management experience; detail-oriented, with a track record of taking ownership of complex work</li> <li>Ability to extract, analyse, and review data and make sound recommendations</li> <li>Comfortable working in a fast-paced, informal, and often ambiguous environment</li> <li>Able to work both autonomously and collaboratively within a team</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>An advanced degree (e.g. LLM in Tax, MSc in Accounting)</li> <li>Experience in technology, payments, or financial services</li> <li>Experience in a high-growth or rapidly scaling environment</li> <li>A genuine enthusiasm for working with a curious, close-knit team of tax professionals who care deeply about Stripe's tax challenges — and each other</li> </ul>

jobs.title: Integration Engineer, Metronome
jobs.description: <h2><strong>Who we are </strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</span></p> <p>Metronome is the leading usage-based billing platform built for modern software companies. With Metronome, companies can launch products faster, offer any pricing model, and streamline finance workflows without writing code. Our platform computes millions of invoices per billing period and is scaling rapidly to accommodate new customers, saving them hours of development time and manual invoicing and enabling them to use consumption data to better serve their customers. Our customers love our product and approach, and we’re humbled to work with amazing companies like OpenAI, Databricks, NVIDIA, Confluent, and Anthropic.</p> <p>You'll be joining an experienced team that includes founders who have successfully built and sold startups before. Our founders and employees have direct experience building and scaling teams through massive growth at companies like Dropbox, Clever, and New Relic. On the back of this experience and our success-to-date, we’ve raised over $128M from leading investors including NEA, Andreessen Horowitz, General Catalyst, Elad Gil, and Workday Ventures. We’re also proud to have founders and executives of companies like Segment, Plaid, Looker, Gitlab, Confluent, HashiCorp, and Snowflake, as investors who have experienced the pain we're solving firsthand.</p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>The Solutions Architecture team at Metronome is a technical group that sits at the intersection of sales, growth, product, and R&D. In simple terms, we own the technical aspects of the customer lifecycle between after sales and before handoff to post-implementation teams. </p> <p>As a member of the Solutions Architecture team, you’ll primarily be focused on ensuring customers successfully implement Metronome’s products and realize value quickly.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Using proficient discovery and scoping  to understand what challenges our clients face in billing, launching new products, pricing & packaging, quote-to-cash, customer experience, and related areas.</li> <li>Doing whatever it takes to support clients throughout the entire implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, technical design, integration design, testing, data migration, and launch. </li> <li>Providing expert guidance to clients regarding usage-based pricing and consumption business models.</li> <li>Hands on configuration of Metronome’s system on behalf of clients</li> <li>Designing integrations between Metronome’s APIs and the clients business systems to align to Metronome best practices (including CRM/ CPQ, Payments, Taxation, ERP, Billing Providers, Reporting and Analytics tools).</li> <li>Acting as a  liaison between the field and Metronome R&D to advocate for client needs and feature requests.  </li> <li>Partnering with implementation managers and other project team members to provide visibility into progress and proactively identify risks and issues</li> <li>Building relationships with people at our client organizations, from day-to-day operators to C-Suite executives. We believe in meeting our customers in-person whenever possible. </li> <li>Designing integrations of Metronome into prospect systems and consultatively influencing the direction of our prospects’ pricing and packaging.</li> <li>Ensuring a proper handoff to our post-implementation teams (Customer Success and Technical Support).</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</span></p> <p>Expect these engagements to be complex, deep, technical, and most of all <em>interesting</em>. Metronome directly influences how the internet monetizes - AI is an obvious current example - and our group is on the front lines driving this influence with our prospects. Metronome is a startup. As such, there’s a lot still to figure out and tremendous room for high-agency people to impact our direction and strategy, build processes from zero to one, and generally <em>make a difference.</em> If this excites you as much as it excites us, let’s talk.</p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience working in technical and/or customer-facing roles involving SaaS products (for example, roles like sales engineering, solutions architecture, technical account management).</li> <li>Deep knowledge of the quote-to-cash space, including integrating with or otherwise interacting with tools like Salesforce, NetSuite, CPQs, Billing, Tax, Payments, etc.</li> <li>Experience leading complex, multi-phase technology transformation programs for enterprise companies.</li> <li>Experience in fast-moving startup environments that value high agency.</li> <li>Ability to quickly learn and communicate technical concepts to technical, go-to-market, and finance stakeholders.</li> <li>Excitement for building and improving GTM playbooks, processes, and reusable assets.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience as a software engineer, product manager, or in other technical roles.</li> <li>Strong understanding of project management and program management fundamentals and principles </li> <li>Experience working with users from one or more of the following personas: Finance/ CFO, Engineering/ CTO, Product/ CPO, Sales Ops/ CRO, and Billing Operations. </li> <li>Experience with logs, metrics, billing, finance, or other infrastructure or financial tooling and concepts.</li> </ul>

jobs.title: Privacy Operations Program Manager

Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h3 id="about-the-team">About the team</h3> <p>The Privacy Operations team is a pivotal part of the global privacy program at Stripe. Our vision is operational excellence—a team that is proactive, streamlined, and deeply embedded in the way Stripe works. Privacy Operations is the authoritative operational hub for privacy processes, enabling high-quality privacy experiences for users and data subjects, and owning clear and auditable documentation for internal stakeholders and external regulators. We partner with Privacy Legal and Privacy Engineering to protect user data.</p> <h2 id="what-youll-do">What you'll do</h2> <p>In this role, you'll own the programs central to how Stripe handles privacy at scale. You'll drive end-to-end management across data subject requests, privacy impact assessments, records of processing activities, transfer impact assessments, and cookie compliance, making day-to-day decisions that keep operations regulatory-ready and auditable. You'll also identify where processes can be tightened or automated, and build the documentation and tooling that make the team's work consistent and sustainable.</p> <p>You'll work as a key connector between Privacy Legal, Privacy Engineering, and cross-functional partners across the company, translating global privacy requirements into practical operations. As a primary point of contact for incoming privacy requests, you'll handle triage and routing, and build the playbooks and response libraries that allow the team to deliver high-quality, consistent privacy experiences for Stripe users and for the regulators who depend on clear, auditable records.</p> <h3 id="responsibilities">Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Own end-to-end program management across core privacy programs such as data subject requests (DSRs), PIAs and DPIAs, records of processing activities (ROPA), transfer impact assessments (TIAs), and cookie compliance, making day-to-day operational decisions, enforcing processes to ensure regulatory readiness, and measuring compliance at scale </li> <li>Identify and implement process improvements, including leveraging AI tooling to automate routine tasks, developing structured workflows to sustain quality standards, and maintaining accurate, auditable program records including playbooks and process documentation</li> <li>Create and maintain clear, auditable privacy documentation, including privacy assessments, program playbooks, and customer response libraries, to provide scalable, consistent privacy operational support</li> <li>Work with Privacy Legal and Privacy Engineering to fulfill user requests, build and deepen expertise on global privacy and data-protection requirements, and escalate novel or complex requests with appropriate context and documentation</li> <li>Rotate through the team's weekly runner model as the primary point of contact for incoming privacy requests, routing across intake channels and managing Jira run tickets</li> </ul> <h2 id="who-you-are">Who you are</h2> <p>We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3 id="minimum-requirements">Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of demonstrated privacy program management and a proven track record of operationalising and scaling cross-functional organisation-wide programs from the ground up</li> <li>Excellent collaboration, communication, and relationship-building skills, and the ability to convey complex ideas succinctly to all audiences</li> <li>Demonstrated experience with privacy legislation such as GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, and PIPEDA. Experience with US state legislation, HIPAA, and GLBA is a plus.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with privacy impact assessments (PIAs and DPIAs), data subject request workflows, records of processing activities (ROPA), or other core privacy program operations</li> <li>Ability to analyze complex problems to identify root causes and trends, and to document complex narratives in a simplified way that others can use</li> <li>Curious and self-motivated with a strong affinity for vision setting, strategic problem solving, and driving outcomes</li> <li>Experienced in juggling multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with tight timelines and shifting priorities</li> <li>A team player, willing to pitch in where needed</li> </ul> <h3 id="preferred-qualifications">Preferred qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Experience in fast-paced, high-growth environments. Previous tech industry experience is a plus.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience using AI to accelerate day-to-day privacy operations work</li> <li>Experience with third-party risk management, RFP and DDQ response processes, or cross-border transfer assessments</li> <li>Privacy certification such as CIPP/E, CIPP/US, or CIPM is a plus</li> </ul>

jobs.title: Product Manager, Professional Services
jobs.description: <h2> </h2> <h2>Stripe · Professional Services · Global Transformation team · Dublin or London</h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>Stripe's Professional Services (ProServ) team helps businesses around the world design, implement, and optimise their Stripe integrations. As we scale our global delivery capability, we are building a structured portfolio of service offerings that define the scope, methodology, resourcing, and commercial terms of how we engage with our users.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a <strong>Product Manager (</strong><strong>Professional Services)</strong> to own the portfolio of offerings end-to-end. The role sits at the intersection of services strategy, commercial design, and delivery operations. You will be the person who determines whether our offerings are well-designed, effectively sold, and profitably delivered and you will take action to refine the portfolio as needed. </p> <p>This is not a traditional Product Manager role, but it demands the same rigour. Your "product" is the service itself: its scope, its pricing, its methodology, and its performance. You will work closely with Sales, Delivery, Finance, and Stripe's Product organisation to ensure that every offering in our portfolio is fit for purpose and continuously improving.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Own the offering portfolio for Professional Services </strong></h3> <ul> <li>Maintain and govern ProServ’s offering portfolio including scope, hours, pricing, and resource plans for each offering. Our portfolio includes offerings designed  for all user segments from start-ups to enterprises</li> <li>Manage the full offering lifecycle: design, build, launch, iterate, and deprecate offerings based on market need, delivery performance, and product roadmap changes</li> <li>Ensure the portfolio stays current as Stripe launches new products </li> <li>Design and implement a governance framework for the portfolio of offerings</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Drive offering performance analytics</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Define and track the offering KPIs: attach rate, average scope deviation, planned vs. actual burn rate, gross margin per offering, and customer satisfaction </li> <li>Run regular performance reviews and present findings to ProServ leadership with clear recommendations</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Refine and Improve Offering Design</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Analyse delivery burn data to identify offerings that are systematically over- or under-scoped, and propose refinements </li> <li>Conduct structured retrospectives with Delivery Leads after engagement close to capture insights and feedback</li> <li>Serve as the structured feedback loop between Delivery (what is hard to deliver), Sales (what is hard to sell), and Finance (what is margin-accretive), synthesising those inputs into offering design decisions</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Required</strong></h3> <ul> <li>7+ years of Professional Services or consulting delivery experience</li> <li>Demonstrable experience shaping or owning a service offering</li> <li>Commercial literacy </li> <li>Strong analytical skills </li> <li>Excellent written communication </li> <li>Product Management training or experience</li> <li>The ability to apply product thinking (hypothesis, prototype, measure, iterate) to service design</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Familiarity with Certinia and/or Salesforce</li> <li>Exposure to partner and SI ecosystem dynamics</li> </ul>

jobs.title: Risk Partnerships Manager, Banks & Treasury
jobs.description: <h2><strong>Who we are </strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</span></p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>The Risk Partnerships team is an essential part of Stripe’s Global Partnerships organization. Our team is responsible for building and maintaining relationships with key partner banks to manage risk for Stripe’s business activities. These banking partnerships are essential to enable Stripe to accept and make payments, provide credit, move & store money and develop new products and solutions to meet our users’ needs. We work across a broad range of risk and compliance topics including; credit, fraud, regulatory, financial crime, reputational, product and operational risks.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>We are seeking a new team member to collaborate with key banking partners throughout the UK, Europe and Stripe’s global partner network. These partners will work with Stripe to develop and deliver solutions that will build our Global Payments and Treasury Network. This role will support Stripe's goals to enable users to send and receive payments domestically and internationally, store funds securely, earn yield on those funds, and enable multi-currency fund flows.</p> <p>Risk management is essential for managing these relationships, and this role requires a broad understanding of risk disciplines across banking activities, including accepting and making payments, money storage & transmission, and multi-currency/cross border fund flow.</p> <p>This role will lead activities to enhance risk management interactions between Stripe and its partners, manage key aspects of the partner relationships, and execute high-impact initiatives.</p> <p>This role will work closely with key internal and external stakeholders to set objectives, coordinate priorities and drive execution. Internally, this role will coordinate closely with product and engineering teams, and cross-functional stakeholders including Risk, Fraud, Financial Crime & Supportability, Operations, Legal and Finance. Externally, this role will work closely with Partners' Risk & Compliance teams, including senior management.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead risk-focused initiatives in collaboration with global financial partners (banks, networks, payment methods) to: <ul> <li>Foster new business opportunities and user verticals</li> <li>Innovate on shared risk methodologies</li> <li>Establish and maintain compliance with agreed risk appetites</li> </ul> </li> <li>Oversee and maintain the health of relationships with key risk counterparts at partner banks</li> <li>Develop and manage projects and initiatives that support strong partner relationships regarding risk</li> <li>Deliver business and policy recommendations that inform our risk posture</li> <li>Act as a representative and negotiator of our risk approach to banking partners</li> <li>Enhance existing and develop new partner-facing risk management capabilities</li> <li>Lead risk-related partnership and product discussions with banking partners to align on risk approaches and strategies</li> <li>Identify and pursue business opportunities by creating innovative risk-aware solutions that expand our product and user base through banking partnership</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</span></p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years experience in risk-related role at a bank or fintech with experience of products & services that enabled users to send and receive payments domestically and internationally, store funds securely, earn yield on those funds, and enable multi-currency fund flows.</li> <li>Demonstrated deep knowledge and experience of working with bank payment schemes and networks (e.g. FPS, BACs, SEPA, ACH and local equivalents)</li> <li>A deep knowledge of risk and compliance issues.</li> <li>Ability to represent Stripe on risk, compliance, and product issues with banking partners to maintain positive relationships.</li> <li>Strong organizational, planning, and communication skills (written and verbal) to drive understanding, collaboration, and issue resolution.</li> <li>Curiosity and a partnership mindset focused on improving processes and scaling solutions.</li> <li>First-hand experience in risk management at a bank or fintech</li> <li>Strong stakeholder management skills, including navigating difficult situations, negotiating timelines, and influencing stakeholders across organizations and borders.</li> <li>Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to thrive in uncertain and ambiguous environments.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience of financial crime programmes including; KYC/B, AML, Sanctions and Terrorist Financing, with a practical knowledge of the Bank Secrecy Act and Anti-Money Laundering regulations.</li> <li>A deep understanding of domestic & international payment schemes (e.g. FPS, CHAPS, BACs, SEPA, ACH, Wire).</li> <li>Strong understanding of the complex risks that are present when managing crossborder payments, including the management of high risk sectors.</li> <li>Market experience across UK & Europe, with an understanding of how current and future regulations will impact Stripe and it’s banking partners.</li> <li>Experience of leveraging technology to support the development and embedment of scalable risk and operational processes.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Us</strong></h3> <p>At Stripe, we're building a financial system for the internet. We're hiring talented people like you to help us make this vision a reality.</p>

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Connect Tax Reporting
jobs.description: <h2>Who we are</h2> <h3>About Stripe</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. When millions of payments flow through a marketplace or platform, the rules for what gets reported, to whom, in which format, and by when are complex, high-stakes, and vary by country. The Connect Tax Reporting team builds products to help businesses collect and verify tax information, prepare and deliver tax forms, and manage reporting obligations across jurisdictions. This includes 1099 reporting in the US and digital platform reporting across the EU, Australia, Canada, the UK, and other regions.</p> <p>This is a domain where correctness, reliability, and user trust matter deeply. A late filing, an incorrect form, or a missed reporting threshold can create regulatory risk and erode trust with platforms and their sellers. Our systems handle high-volume seasonal workflows, support complex country-specific rules, and remain dependable under fixed filing deadlines.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <p>You’ll build products and systems that simplify tax reporting for platforms and their users. You’ll take projects from discovery and technical design through implementation, launch, and operation.</p> <p>Your work may include improving tax information collection, building APIs and data pipelines, automating reporting processes, and strengthening the reliability of production systems. You’ll collaborate with product managers, tax operations, support, and engineers across Stripe. AI-assisted development will be part of your day-to-day work as you design, build, test, and operate software.</p> <p> </p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Design, build, and operate features across tax reporting user experiences, APIs, services, and data workflows</li> <li>Turn user and business needs into clear technical approaches and deliver projects from concept to launch</li> <li> Build scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable software supported by appropriate tests</li> <li> Improve tax reporting workflows through automation and operational tooling</li> <li> Review code and collaborate with engineers to improve implementation quality and share technical context</li> <li> Monitor production systems, respond to incidents, and improve reliability, observability, and runbooks</li> <li> Partner with product, tax operations, support, and engineering teams to deliver solutions that meet user needs</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</span></p> <h3>Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li><strong>4 years of</strong> experience building, testing, and maintaining production software in one or more general-purpose programming languages (Ruby, TypeScript, Python, Java, C#, etc.).</li> <li>Experience delivering software projects from problem definition through launch</li> <li>Ability to make technical decisions and communicate tradeoffs through code, design documents, and technical discussions</li> <li>Experience debugging and operating production systems</li> <li>Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span></h3> <ul> <li>Experience building backend services, APIs, batch workflows, data pipelines, or user-facing product experiences</li> <li>Experience with distributed systems, asynchronous processing, large-scale data workflows, or search infrastructure</li> <li> Experience with financial, compliance, reporting, or other systems where correctness, privacy, and data integrity matter</li> <li>Interest in learning tax reporting concepts and building products for platforms and their users</li> </ul>

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Intern
jobs.description: <h2><strong>Who we are</strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million <a href="https://stripe.com/customers">businesses</a> build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make <a href="https://stripe.com/roadmap">upgrades to our products</a> every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most <a href="https://status.stripe.com/">reliable APIs</a> on the internet. We build entirely new <a href="https://tempo.xyz/">pieces</a> of <a href="https://mpp.dev/">financial</a> <a href="https://joinopenstandard.com/">infrastructure</a> to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in <a href="https://stripe.com/radar">risk and fraud</a> infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. </p> <p>Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>As an intern at Stripe you’ll work on projects across our stack that directly impact the way millions of businesses operate. You’ll own problems end to end with the support of your manager and teammates. It’s an opportunity to work alongside some of the most creative and technically rigorous engineers in the industry and learn how to ship high-quality work at scale. By contributing to Stripe’s codebase you’ll work across domains that give you insight into how the global economy works. Recent intern projects include expanding Stripe’s Payments Foundation Model capabilities to improve generalized anomaly detection, building more approachable fraud controls, creating safer payouts, and developing user-facing solutions that prevent costly pricing mistakes and make merchant checkout setup easier.</p> <p>Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high. </p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Operate as a real member of the team you join; engage in team discussions, decisions, and the technical design process.</li> <li>Write software that will be used in production, and has meaningful impact to Stripe’s business and users.</li> <li>Give and receive technical feedback through code reviews or design discussions</li> <li>Collaborate with other engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to proactively seek and incorporate feedback.</li> <li>Learn quickly by asking great questions, working with your intern manager and teammates effectively, communicating the status of your work clearly, and building with the latest AI tooling.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.</li> <li>Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. </li> <li>Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>A strong fundamental understanding of computer science through pursuit of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, math, or a related discipline. </li> <li>Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Ruby, Java, Javascript, Go, and Scala. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present.</li> <li>Experience from previous internships or other multi-person projects, including open source contributions, that demonstrate evaluating and receiving feedback from mentors, peers, and stakeholders.</li> <li>Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts. </li> <li>Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>At least 1 year of university education, or equivalent work experience.</li> <li>One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge. </li> <li>Experience writing high quality pull requests, with good test coverage, and working knowledge to complete projects with minimal defects.</li> <li>Familiarity with navigating and managing your work in new code bases, with multiple languages.</li> <li>Clear written communication skills, with the ability to write clearly to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes.</li> </ul>

Optimized Checkout and Link teams work to create best-in-class checkout experiences that enhance customer satisfaction and drive merchant conversion rates. The Risk Engineering team develops products that minimize financial and regulatory risks while ensuring a seamless user experience, thereby safeguarding Stripe's brand and financial stability.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <p>We're looking for backend, frontend-leaning fullstack, and fullstack engineers who are interested in building software services and platforms that impact thousands of employees and millions of Stripe users, regardless of whether they're an end user, developer, or partner.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Scope, design, build, and maintain APIs, user experiences, services, and large-scale systems that reliably and efficiently handle billions of money movement requests</li> <li>Debug and solve critical production issues across services and multiple levels of the stack</li> <li>Mentor engineers to help them grow</li> <li>Meet directly with our users to help shape product changes</li> <li>Collaborate with stakeholders across the company to build new features at large-scale, while improving internal engineering standards, tooling, and processes</li> <li>Collaborate effectively in a distributed and hybrid team, maintaining open communication and strong connections with colleagues</li> </ul> <h2>Who you are</h2> <p>We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. jobs.title: Solutions Architect, Metronome (AI Native)
jobs.description: <h2>About Us</h2> <p>Metronome is the leading usage-based billing platform built for modern software companies. With Metronome, now a Stripe product, companies can launch products faster, offer any pricing model, and streamline finance workflows without writing code.</p> <p>Our platform computes hundreds of millions of invoices per billing period and continues to scale rapidly to accommodate new customers. We save them days of development time and manual invoicing, enabling them to use their billing data to better serve their customers. Our customers love our product and approach, and we’re humbled to work with amazing companies like OpenAI, Anthropic, NVIDIA, TogetherAI, HuggingFace, and many others.</p> <p>You'll be joining an experienced team that includes founders who have successfully built and sold startups before. Our Stripes have direct experience building and scaling teams through massive growth at companies like Dropbox, Palantir, and MongoDB. You'll be joining Stripe and be part of the holistic Stripe platform approaching monetization.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>The Metronome AI Native Solutions team operates at the intersection of technical sales, implementation, and customer success, purpose-built for the velocity and unique needs of AI-first companies. Unlike traditional sales engineering roles, this position owns the large parts of if not all of the deal cycle - from first call through technical win - and gets hands-on with implementation to ensure customers go live quickly.</p> <p>As an AI Native Solutions Architect, you'll be the primary technical owner for fast-moving AI companies that may need to launch usage-based billing on tight timelines. This means:</p> <p><strong>Owning the technical win:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Taking qualified inbound leads and driving them through discovery, demo, POC, and technical win</li> <li>Using efficient discovery to quickly understand billing challenges, product launch timelines, and technical requirements</li> <li>Bringing energy and urgency to every engagement—proactively driving deals forward, identifying blockers early, and building relationships across the customer organization (engineering, finance, product) to create champions</li> <li>Running streamlined demos tailored to technical founders and product/engineering teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>Driving hands-on implementation:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Providing customers with clear, actionable implementation plans to implement their usage-based billing launches</li> <li>Writing code snippets, configuration examples, and integration guides to accelerate customer time-to-value</li> <li>Pair programming or working alongside customer teams during POCs and initial setup</li> <li>Designing up/downstream integrations into prospect systems with a bias toward pragmatic solutions that get them live quickly</li> </ul> <p><strong>Building deep AI market expertise:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Building relationships with technical founders, engineering leaders, product, and finance teams at AI companies</li> <li>Understanding the unique monetization challenges facing LLM providers, generative AI companies (image, video, audio), and AI tooling/wrapper companies and providing consultative guidance when prospects need direction on pricing and packaging strategy and implementation</li> <li>Staying current on AI industry trends, pricing models, and competitive dynamics</li> </ul> <p>This role is perfect for someone who thrives in high-velocity environments, loves solving technical problems in real-time, and wants to be on the front lines of how AI companies monetize their products. Metronome directly influences how the next generation of AI infrastructure gets built—and our AI Native Solutions team drives this influence with our fastest-growing customer segment.</p> <p>The Metronome team still operates very much like a startup. As such, there's a lot still to figure out and tremendous room for high-agency, curious individuals to impact our direction and strategy, build processes from zero to one, and generally make a difference. If this excites you as much as it excites us, let's talk.</p> <h2>Qualifications</h2> <p>This is roughly the set of things we’re looking for - if you’re interested in this role and don’t meet some of these on paper, err on the side of applying!</p> <ul> <li>3+ years of experience in technical, customer-facing roles involving SaaS products (for example, sales engineering, solutions architecture, technical account management, implementation consulting)</li> <li>1+ years of experience working with, at, or selling to AI companies - you understand how AI-first companies operate, their unique challenges, and the market landscape</li> <li>Proven ability to own and drive customer-facing engagements and relationships independently</li> <li>Strong technical aptitude with the ability to quickly learn new systems, write code snippets, and guide technical implementations</li> <li>Experience working in high-velocity environments where speed-to-value matters and customers need to launch quickly</li> <li>Excellent communication skills with technical buyers (engineers, product managers, technical founders)</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Deep knowledge of the quote-to-cash space, including integrating with or otherwise interacting with tools like Salesforce, NetSuite, CPQs, etc.</li> <li>Experience as a software engineer, product manager, or in other technical roles.</li> <li>Experience in a pure sales role, particularly selling to technical buyers in engineering and product organizations or selling as a founding or early salesperson at a startup.</li> <li>Familiarity and enthusiasm for AI developer tooling (Cursor, Lovable, Vercel, LangChain, etc.) and the broader AI infrastructure ecosystem</li> </ul>
